title: Canonical section-degree comparison respects tensor multiplication
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L invertible, j.ker²=0, n,e≥0, and D the canonical TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. For f:O_Z→(j*L)^n and x:O_Z→((j*L)^n)^(e+1), transport their tensor product through the inverse pullback tensor comparison, pullback of tensorPowAddIso inverse, and the equality n+n(e+1)=n(e+2). The resulting section is the value at 1 of lambda inverse followed by f tensor x and D.a_(e+1) inverse. The first input section is tensorPowSection f 1 followed by D.a_0 inverse. This statement uses no graded algebra or presentation.

proof.text: Replace D by canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons using hD. Its section comparison is boundaryPullbackPowIso followed by tensorPowMulIso. Expand these recursive isomorphisms, and use naturality of boundaryPullbackComparison and the monoidal pullback tensorator. The tensor-power addition map groups the first n factors and the remaining n(e+1) factors; the tensor-power multiplication map groups the same factors into blocks of n. Associator coherence identifies these groupings. The degree-one power tensorPowSection f 1 is f followed by the inverse right unitor; its unitor cancels the degree-one tensorPowMulIso. Evaluate the resulting morphism equality at 1, using tensorHom_app_tmulSection and the inverse left unitor formula. The arithmetic equality hdeg only transports the target degree. For n=0 all factors are units and the same triangle and unitor identities apply; for e=0 the argument is the two-block case. No graded presentation or cohomology property is used.

theorem tensorSectionProduct_comparison {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n).tensorPow (e + 1))
    (hdeg : n * (0 + 1) + n * (e + 1) = n * ((e + 1) + 1)) :
    ((tensorPullback j).map (eqToHom (congrArg L.tensorPow hdeg))).app ⊤
      (((tensorPullback j).map
        (L.tensorPowAddIso (n * (0 + 1)) (n * (e + 1))).inv).app ⊤
        ((boundaryPullbackTensorIso j (L.tensorPow (n * (0 + 1)))
          (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1)))).inv.app ⊤
          (tmulSection
            ((tensorPowSection f 1 ≫ (D.a 0).inv).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
            ((x ≫ (D.a e).inv).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))))) =
      ((((λ_ (𝟙_ Z.Modules)).inv ≫ (f ⊗ₘ x)) ≫ (D.a (e + 1)).inv).app ⊤
        (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
